modes.name: Memory of Chaos
modes.buff: The character in position 1 of the ally lineup gains the Elation Skill "Euphoric Maelstrom," dealing 100% Elation DMG of the character's Type to all enemies. At the start of each cycle, Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn, taking into account a fixed 20 Punchlines. This turn does not consume Punchlines.

modes.name: Pure Fiction
modes.buff: Each time Punchline is gained, allies will additionally accumulate 2 Grit Value.

buffs.name: Concordant Truce
buffs.description: This stage has a special Elation Skill. When entering Aha Instant, deals 15 instance(s) of Imaginary Elation DMG to a random enemy target. When an enemy target is defeated by any target, obtains 1 Punchline point(s).

buffs.name: Surging Grit
buffs.description: Upon entering "Surging Grit," Aha immediately gains an extra turn where a fixed amount of 20 Punchline is taken into account. During this turn, Punchline is not consumed, and Elation Skill DMG dealt is 50% of the original DMG. During "Surging Grit," DMG taken by enemy targets increases by 50%, and Aha Instant's SPD increases by 40.

selectableBuffs.name: Euphoria
selectableBuffs.description: During "Surging Grit," enemy targets take 30% more Elation DMG, and additionally increases Aha Instant's SPD by 20.

selectableBuffs.name: Delirium
selectableBuffs.description: After an ally target uses their Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 Punchline. During Surging Grit, the ally targets' DMG dealt increases by 50%. For each enemy target hit with Basic ATK or Skill, ally team additionally accumulates Grit Value.

selectableBuffs.name: Riddle Fanatic
selectableBuffs.description: After an ally memosprite uses an attack, gains 2 Punchline. During Surging Grit, DMG dealt by ally memosprites increases by 50%. After memosprites' attacks, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

modes.name: Apocalyptic Shadow
modes.buff: When an enemy target with "Steadfast Safeguard" is inflicted with Weakness Break, dispels control states from all allies, action advances, and grants Aha an extra turn (this turn will count as 10 fixed Punchline points). Increases Ultimate DMG dealt to all enemies by 25% and Elation DMG by 15%.

traits.name: Steadfast Safeguard
traits.description: Boss Mirage takes 50% less DMG. After Weakness is broken, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by 100%.

traits.name: Battlefield Transfer
traits.description: Boss Mirage summons 2 Elite Enemies to assist in battle. Boss Mirage will transmit its own Weakness Type to summons, but when those summons are defeated, Boss Mirage's Toughness will be additionally reduced.

traits.name: Stellar Aegis
traits.description: For every unit on the enemy's side of the field aside from Boss Mirage, all enemies receive less DMG.

traits.name: Turn Back the Tide
traits.description: When the Boss Mirage uses "Puppet Understudy" in its second phase, it will apply Enhancement effects to all summons.

axiomBuffs.name: Magic Time
axiomBuffs.description: At the start of battle, when there are 1/2/3/4 Elation character(s) in the team, increases the Elation of all allies by 10%/20%/30%/40%.

axiomBuffs.name: Collapse on Sight
axiomBuffs.description: Increases all enemies' Break DMG taken by 10%. After Breaking an enemy's Weakness, increases all allies' SPD by 15% for 2 turn(s).

axiomBuffs.name: Moment of Opportunity
axiomBuffs.description: Increases Follow-Up ATK and Ultimate DMG dealt by all allies by 50%, and additionally increases by 50% against enemy targets in Weakness Broken state.

traits.name: Steadfast Safeguard
traits.description: Boss Mirage takes 50% less DMG. After Weakness is Broken, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by 100%.

traits.name: Singularity Split
traits.description: At the start of combat and during phase transitions, the Boss Mirage splits into 5 "ichor memosprites" and applies "Monoform Merger" to these summons. When all "ichor memosprites" with "Monoform Merger" enter the "Feigned Death" state, they merge back into the Boss Mirage.

traits.name: Mutual Complement
traits.description: Increases the Max HP of the "ichor memosprites" summoned after the Boss Mirage's split, and the "ichor memosprites" summoned after the split in the second phase have Shared HP.

traits.name: Economies of Scale
traits.description: For every unit on the enemy's side of the field that is not in the "Feigned Death" state aside from Boss Mirage, all enemies receive less DMG and deal more DMG.

axiomBuffs.name: Comic Relief
axiomBuffs.description: After an ally target uses an attack that deals Elation DMG, inflicts Vulnerability on the target receiving Elation DMG, increasing the DMG they take by 15% for 2 turn(s). This effect can trigger up to 1 time per enemy target per attack.

axiomBuffs.name: Exploit Opening
axiomBuffs.description: After any ally target inflicts a debuff to an enemy target, increases their CRIT DMG by 75% for 2 turn(s).

axiomBuffs.name: Land of Fertility
axiomBuffs.description: Increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by all allies by 30%, and additionally increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by the 1st character in the lineup by 30%.\

traits.name: Steadfast Safeguard
traits.description: Decreases DMG taken by Boss Mirage by 50%. After its Weakness is broken, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by 100%.

traits.name: Better Safe Than Sorry
traits.description: When the Boss Mirage uses "Barrenness of Earth Gouged," all other Wolftroopers will be eliminated.

traits.name: Apex Predator
traits.description: After Boss Mirage enters Phase II, it gains extra action per turn during "Going Solo."

traits.name: Till Death
traits.description: After Boss Mirage enters "Going Solo," reduces its DMG taken by an additional 60%.

axiomBuffs.name: Unstoppable Force
axiomBuffs.description: DMG dealt by memosprites ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

axiomBuffs.name: Heroic Vanguard
axiomBuffs.description: After the character in position 1 in the team uses Ultimate, their Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 50% and increases CRIT DMG by 50%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

axiomBuffs.name: Unto Apotheosis
axiomBuffs.description: When ally targets consume Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 10 times.

selectableBuffs.name: Ecstasy Night
selectableBuffs.description: Merrymakes Elation DMG dealt by the character in position 1 of the ally lineup by 50%.

selectableBuffs.name: Navigator's Oath
selectableBuffs.description: Increases the All-Type RES PEN for the Skill DMG and Ultimate DMG dealt by the character in position 1 in the lineup by 50%.

selectableBuffs.name: Endocytosis
selectableBuffs.description: "Homeostatic Imbalance" increases DMG dealt to "Blood-Brain Barrier" by 50%.
